top_choice_rationale: P001 credits Katori and Ye with a well-bounded invention, the optical lattice clock: magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms removes Doppler, recoil and light-shift errors while keeping the statistics, and it has been taken to 10^-18 and reproduced and intercompared in independent laboratories. The two-name allocation is uncontested among members who proposed laureates, and the citation is a step distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-quantum-system prizes. No award would withhold a mature, clearly attributable achievement.
